The same-frame clause in 8.13 does not identify when its mass change is an invariant system-mass change.
findings.affectedCorrection: Name total energy in 8.12; clarify comparison of the same matter and retained energy in the gas/kettle system at rest, and distinguish the rest-frame system-energy case in 8.13. Keep all formula tokens, numerical data, provenance and original questions.

The next block calls the term the usual low-speed kinetic energy without restricting that identification to the retained approximation order.
findings.affectedCorrection: Explain in words that using relativistic rather than rest mass changes the kinetic term only at fourth order in speed/light-speed ratio, outside retained second-order accuracy. Qualify the following kinetic-energy identification to that order. Retain 8.14 and the 8.11 footnote verbatim in mathematical content; add no formulas or numerical task data.
